name: UBS USD Money Market Investment Fund Token
oneLiner: UMINT is UBS's accumulating Ethereum money-market fund share, redeemable through authorized distributors with privately disclosed portfolio terms.
collateral: Native tokenized participating shares in a Singapore VCC money-market sub-fund managed by UBS Asset Management (Singapore). The distributor names State Street Bank and Trust as custodian/administrator and high-quality money-market instruments; exact underlying strategy, private placement memorandum and current position weights are not publicly disclosed.
pegMechanism: Accumulating native Ethereum money-market fund share, subscribed and redeemed through authorized distributors such as DigiFT at NAV. UBS confirms an in-production subscription and redemption workflow. The 2025 distributor dossier describes daily T+0 dealing, but current contractual cutoffs, fees, minimums and unconditional capacity are not publicly established. DigiFT DR-uMINT is a separate receipt and is excluded from native identity and supply.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The exact deployment represents a USD short-duration money-market fund share with ordinary NAV redemption. The tbill family models the fund/NAV mechanism; it does not imply Treasury-only holdings. The share is not a wrapper of any tracked stablecoin.
